name: mo-workspace
description: 墨水互动叙事游戏编辑器工作区

scripts.install:all: npm.cmd --prefix frontend install && npm.cmd --prefix backend install && npm.cmd --prefix player-standalone install && npm.cmd --prefix player-standalone/visual-novel install && npm.cmd --prefix packager-win install
scripts.dev:frontend: npm.cmd run build:player && npm.cmd --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build:frontend: npm.cmd run build:player && npm.cmd --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm.cmd --prefix frontend run type-check && npm.cmd --prefix backend run build
scripts.verify: npm.cmd run typecheck && npm.cmd run test:unit && npm.cmd run build:frontend
